The TPT panel is a light two-system sleeve: DONC SEA -2.3 / FFW -4.0 (panel -2.64 after the 40% shrink to the unweighted median -3.15) and DONC 44.26 / FFW 44.0 on the total (panel 44.21); Pi-Rate, Lou St. John, RP Excel, Laffaye RWP and Dokter Entropy are blank in TPT's own file and no single-computer clamp was recorded. Origin: SEA -4.19, total 46.36, home WP 0.621 on nfelo's line-to-WP curve. The team-total split is not 50/50 because the identity already skews it by the spread (≈ SEA 25.3 / NE 21.1) and a ±0.5 pace-possession reallocation (SEA 52.9% pass rate 32nd, 58.6 plays/g 22nd, No. 1 EPA/play defense -0.111; NE 61.2% pass, 59.8 plays/g) moves it to ≈ SEA 25.8 / NE 20.6, consistent in direction with DRatings' diagnostic 23.1 / 20.8.

The TPT panel is light: DONC -4.3 / FF-Winners +2.4 (SF favored) on the spread and DONC 47.78 / FF-Winners 42.5 on the total, with Pi-Rate, Lou St. John, RP Excel, Laffaye and Dokter Entropy blank in TPT's file and no single-computer clamp triggered; the shrunk panel lands at -2.96 and 46.72, i.e. 0.18 points more LA than the Tier-A blend on the spread and 0.89 under nfelo's 47.61 on the total, with FF-Winners the outlier on both (6.7 points from DONC on the spread, 5.3 under DONC on the total), which is what pushes spread_sd to 3.03 across four sources. Cores after weighting: spread LA -2.81 (nfelo .46 / PFF .39 / TPT .15), total 47.17 (nfelo .50 / TPT .50; PFF publishes no total, DVOA 46.93 is diagnostic only). No §5 adjustment is applied: no post-8/31 QB news, no injured-OT/elite-rush pairing (LA's No. 1 PFF pass rush faces a healthy SF OL ranked ~12, and SF's No. 20 rush is not elite against LA's unverified RT change from Havenstein to McClendon Jr.), both teams on 7 days with a symmetric trans-Pacific trip already priced as neutral-site HFA in nfelo and PFF, and no verified forecast or confirmed roof state at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, so weather is flagged rather than priced. Pearsall (IR, WR rank 14 behind Evans/Samuel), Mykel Williams (A02 decode unverified, SLB4), Dimukeje (IR, rotational) and McPhearson (IR, depth CB) are all below the premium-starter bar and zeroed. The team-total split is not 50/50 because the identity already assigns the 2.81-point spread to LA (LA ~25.0 / SF ~22.2 on the 47.17 core) and a +1.0 LA / -1.0 SF explosive-play reallocation is added on top: LA's No. 1 PFF 2025 offense grade (93.6, off EPA/play 0.149, Stafford PFF QB5) meets SF's No. 24 PFF coverage rank, 52.8 defense grade and +0.066 def EPA/play, game total unchanged.

On S=+1.014 and T=46.153 the identity gives BUF 23.58 / HOU 22.57 — BUF about 1.0 above HOU (0.5 each way from the 23.08 midpoint), not 0.5 more than HOU. The brief's own end figure ('roughly 1.5 above HOU' after the -0.25/+0.25 pair) is correct (23.83 / 22.32, gap 1.51) and only reconciles if the identity gap is 1.0, so the sentence is internally inconsistent as written. Fix: 'which already puts BUF about 1.0 above HOU (0.5 each way from the midpoint) on the +1.0 spread'. The tt_split_note phrases it correctly; the brief does not. 2) Minor: '2025 No. 1 EPA/play defense' follows pff_units.home.note; quality_2025.home says 'Defense 2nd-best EPA/play in 2025' with 'def 1st-2nd both sources'. Say '1st-2nd EPA/play defense (sources split)' to match the bundle's own hedge. 3) Precision: 'an absence the bundle shows no engine or computer pricing' — the bundle is silent on DONC/FFW roster inputs, which is absence of evidence, not evidence of absence; the flag list states this correctly ('unresolved for the TPT computers'), the brief should too. games.brief_problems: All published numbers verify against the bundle (PSR -0.50/-2.78, QB 2.5/1.5, spread_pff -4.67, nfelo -3.00 with HFA 2.40 and QB +0.56/+0.18, wp .604, Tier-A blend -3.77, panel -2.38, core -3.56, DONC/FFW totals 42.43/41.90, panel 42.32, nfelo 45.80, gap 3.48, DVOA 45.30, core 44.06, published -4.06/43.06, split 23.56/19.50, S/2 = 2.03, pace 57.4/60.9, blank-system lists, empty system_clamps). Two causal-attribution sentences are inaccurate and must be reworded; neither changes a number. (1) 'sits 1.39 lighter than Tier A entirely because FF-Winners is the outlier' is wrong: Donchess -3.1 is by itself 0.67 lighter than Tier A -3.77, so FF-Winners' pull through the 40% shrink accounts for 0.72 of the 1.39 gap, roughly half, not all of it. Reword to: '0.67 of the gap is Donchess itself sitting lighter than Tier A; the remaining 0.72 is FF-Winners' pull through the shrink.' (2) '0.75 of the 1.0 total reduction falls on the ATL side' misstates the mechanism: the identity split distributes the 1.0 total reduction 0.5/0.5; ATL's net -0.75 (20.25 -> 19.50) is 0.5 from the total plus 0.25 from the -0.5 spread move, and PIT nets -0.25 (23.81 -> 23.56). Reword to state the net per-side change and its two components. Same fix applies to tt_split_note ('0.75 of it landing on ATL through the identity').
